Instead of accessing the PDF to extract the actual first scene heading ('THE CASTLE'), the agent hallucinated that the search summary constituted the official script content, leading to the incorrect final answer.

hypotheses.rationale: This is the decisive error. The agent explicitly extracted the search result text ('E1: Veil...') but failed to verify the actual content of the official script link provided. It hallucinated that 'Veil' was the location name based solely on a scene summary, ignoring the specific instruction to find the location name in the 'first scene heading' (which is known to be 'THE CASTLE'). Had the agent verified the PDF content as per its role specification, it would have found 'THE CASTLE' and prevented the wrong final answer.
